mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte wasting (particularly potassium and magnesium), while pantoprazole may further impair magnesium absorption and increase risk of hypomagnesemia-related complications.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (magnesium, potassium, calcium) closely; consider alternative acid suppression or use lowest effective pantoprazole dose; ensure adequate magnesium supplementation during concurrent therapy.
